related_methods.title: FabricFlowNet
related_methods.zh: 当前→目标深度流；PickNet选抓点，q=p+f(p)给放点。推理需要目标观测。
related_methods.en: Current-to-goal depth correspondence informs picking and analytically supplies placement, q=p+f(p). A goal observation is provided at inference.

related_methods.title: FlowBot3D
related_methods.zh: 预测潜在关节运动方向；几何控制器依flow选接触点，并闭环执行移动方向。
related_methods.en: Predicts potential articulation directions. A geometric controller uses the field to select contact and move in a closed loop.

related_methods.title: FlowBotHD
related_methods.zh: 过去点云＋先前预测flow经乘法条件注入；配合进展筛选与方向一致性检查。
related_methods.en: Earlier point clouds and predicted articulation flow supply multiplicative conditioning, coupled with progress filtering and direction-consistency checks.
